name: nav_low
description: Lowest price of the index during the trading day, in index points. Use for period lows (e.g. MIN(nav_low)) and drawdown or intraday-range context; pairs with nav_high for the day's range. Optional/nullable.

name: inflow
description: Total monetary value (in INR) of assets that flowed into the client's account for this product during the reporting period. Includes fresh investments, SIP instalments, switch-ins, and reinvested dividends. Used to measure client acquisition and deepening activity.

name: net_flow
description: Net money movement for the client and product during the reporting period, calculated as inflow minus outflow (in INR). A positive value indicates net accumulation; a negative value indicates net redemption. A key metric for tracking business momentum, AUM growth, and revenue forecasting.

name: outflow
description: Total monetary value (in INR) of assets that flowed out of the client's account for this product during the reporting period. Includes redemptions, withdrawals, switch-outs, and dividend payouts. Used alongside inflow to compute net new money and assess client attrition or rebalancing activity.

name: period_date
description: Reference date representing the start of the reporting period for which the net new money figures are calculated. Used to track monthly or periodic flows of client assets into and out of the platform. Paired with the inflow, outflow, and net flow fields to compute periodic AUM growth attribution.

name: product_type
description: Category or type of the financial product associated with this record. Indicates the broad instrument class such as 'Direct Equity', 'Mutual Fund', 'Bond', 'NCD', or 'AIF'. Used for asset classâ€“level aggregation, filtering, and regulatory classification across reports and dashboards.

name: holding_period_days
description: Number of calendar days the security was held between the buy date and sell date. Used to classify the gain as short-term or long-term capital gain for tax purposes. For listed equities, gains on holdings â‰¤ 365 days are short-term (STCG at 15%); gains on holdings > 365 days are long-term (LTCG at 10

name: sell_date
description: Date on which the security was sold or redeemed, triggering the realization of the gain or loss. Used as the end date for holding period calculation and as the event date for capital gains tax computation and reporting. Example: '2026-03-27'.

name: amount
description: Total monetary value of the transaction in Indian Rupees (INR), representing the net consideration paid or received. For purchases, this is the total cost including charges; for redemptions, this is the net proceeds received. Primary field for revenue, AUM, and flow analytics.

name: client_id
description: Unique numeric identifier assigned to a client within the wealth management platform. Links this record to the Client Master for accessing client demographics, KYC status, relationship details, and portfolio ownership. Example: 7001.

name: id
description: Unique system-generated surrogate key that identifies each record within this dataset. Auto-incremented integer assigned at the time of record creation. Used as the primary key for joins and lookups within the platform.

name: transaction_date
description: Trade date on which the transaction was executed in the market or processed by the fund house. For equities, this is the exchange execution date; for mutual funds, this is the applicable NAV date. Used for chronological ordering, holding period calculation, and periodic transaction reports.

name: transaction_type
description: Type of financial transaction executed by the client. Defines the nature of the activity such as 'Purchase' (Buy), 'Sale' (Sell), 'Switch In', 'Switch Out', 'SIP', 'Dividend Reinvestment', or 'Transfer'. Drives transaction processing logic, gain/loss calculation, and regulatory reporting classificat

name: total_invested_value
description: Sum of total_cost - the total capital deployed by the client.

name: total_unrealized_gain

name: portfolio_return_pct

name: aum_by_client_by_month

name: unrealized_gain_by_client
description: Total unrealized P&L per client for a given value_date.

name: unrealized_gain_pct
description: Unrealized gain/loss expressed as a percentage of total_cost. Positive = profit, negative = loss. Formula: (market_value - total_cost) / total_cost x 100.

name: valuation_month
description: Calendar month derived from value_date (format YYYY-MM). Used to group valuation records by month for time-series and month-over-month comparisons.

name: gain_loss_flag
description: Classifies each holding snapshot as Gain, Loss, or Breakeven based on unrealized_gain_loss.

name: client_id

name: cost_value

name: market_value

name: unrealized_pnl
description: Unrealized profit or loss on this holding as of value_date (market_value minus total_cost). Positive = holding is in profit; negative = holding is in loss. Reflects the gain or loss if the position were liquidated at value_date prices.

name: valuation_date
